summary: Read resource observation preparation from a rebuildable canonical projection instead of replaying resource and item history

replay.detail: Opening an existing store builds the local preparation projection from retained claims, discovering resource subjects through indexed subject-range and observation-kind searches rather than scanning the whole claim log. Canonical late arrivals, repairs and ordering changes refresh affected subjects; historical at-index reads continue to use the canonical fold. Replicated claim identity and history are unchanged.

schema.detail: Adds local, rebuildable preparation state and dirty tracking alongside resource_observations. The storage version and replicated schema are unchanged. The preparation state preserves the canonical actual value, including legacy flat versus nested facts and first-opener attribution, plus the existing raw timestamp and resource-kind selectors.

rules.detail: No observation frequency, subscription rule, retry, timeout, checkpoint or retention changes. Observer and subscription actual readers are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Resource and item facts, normalization errors, first-opener attribution and preparation timestamps retain their existing selection semantics, including timestamps selected from repaired originals. Preparation point reads share the existing pinned SQLite read cut and preparation fence.

downtime.detail: No manual migration is needed. Initial projection construction is performed during the normal store-open transaction.

manual.detail: No configuration or operator action is required.

recovery.detail: The preparation projection is disposable and reconstructible from retained claims. Downgrading restores historical preparation reads without converting claim data.
